chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ibn Abu Yafour, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) judged regarding a man who died and left a child, so they found a wet-nurse for him. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'The wages of breast-feeding of the child is from what it has inherited from its father and its mother'.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤَمِنِينَ: Amir Al-Momineen (Leader of the Faithful), a title for Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: Who pays for the wet-nurse of an orphaned child according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the wages for a nursing mother are a debt against the orphan's estate, payable from the inheritance received from both father and mother. This ruling underscores the principle that the child's wealth bears the cost of their maintenance, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence regarding inheritance and guardianship (wilayah). It reflects the practical application of Quranic verses on child-rearing, ensuring financial clarity for orphans under the guidance of Imam al-Sadiq (AS).

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who died and left a child, so they found a wet-nurse for him. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wages of breast-feeding of the child is from what it has inherited from its father and its mother’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people from ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin issued a judgment about the case of a man who had died, had left behind a child and they had found someone to breastfeed him. He (the Imam) said that the wages for breastfeeding must be paid from what the child has inherited from his father and mother.’”
